question: Is focused installer regression and website-installer CI proof enough to land this first-run installer fix, or should maintainers require a completed black-box fresh install artifact first?
rationale: The code path is setup/upgrade-sensitive, and the PR body says the full fresh-VPS install proof was terminated before completion, so proof sufficiency is a maintainer risk decision.

options.title: Accept focused proof after docs sync
options.body: Update the installer docs, then rely on the focused installer regression tests plus platform installer CI before normal land.

options.title: Require black-box fresh install proof
options.body: Hold merge until there is a completed fresh install transcript or artifact showing onboarding creates config, gateway auth, and service state.

recommendation.title: Accept focused proof after docs sync
recommendation.body: Update the installer docs, then rely on the focused installer regression tests plus platform installer CI before normal land.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently touched installer/onboarding UX and are the best available owner for deciding the setup proof bar.
